required scenes (story order):
S1: 孟子and孟母lived near a graveyard, and 孟子 imitated how to offer sacrifices every day
S2: 孟母 decided to move away from the neighborhood near the graveyard because she thought imitating how to offer sacrifices would have a bad impact on 孟子
S3: 孟母moved to the neighborhood near the market, 孟子imitated how to buy and sell every day
S4: 孟母 moved from the market to the neighborhood near a school, 孟子started to study every day
S5: 孟子becomes a famous philosopher

learner's story:
古代的时候，有一个才十二岁小男孩子叫孟子。有一天，孟子的妈妈找他的孩子，在当地的墓地找到了他跟别的孩子。妈妈认为他们拿东西，所以她问了，他们为什么拿水果？孟子说他们不是拿东西，而是给祖先水果祭拜。他说他老是来墓地请祖先给他建议。这个天他请他们给他建议怎么减轻他的家庭的负担。妈妈告诉他应该发现教育，然后找一个好的工作。回家以后孟子在家坐着，从早到晚一直学习，教育做完以后孟子考虑，不是当哲学家就是当商家。父母希望他当商家。但是，他从童年老是讨论重要的生活问题，很幸福。另外，孟子认为，当商人会害得他的价值观。难怪他决定成为哲学家，原来他想给别的人建议。

scenes.core: 孟子 and 孟母 live near a graveyard; 孟子 imitates ancestor offerings
evidence: 在当地的墓地找到了他跟别的孩子。
他老是来墓地请祖先给他建议。
scenes.missing_part: 孟子 and 孟母 living near the graveyard

scenes.core: 孟母 moves away from the graveyard because the sacrifice imitation may harm 孟子
scenes.missing_part: 孟母 decides that the graveyard behaviour will have a bad impact on 孟子 and moves away from that neighbourhood

scenes.core: They move near a market; 孟子 imitates buying and selling
scenes.missing_part: 孟母 moves to the market neighbourhood, and 孟子 imitates buying and selling there

scenes.core: They move near a school; 孟子 begins studying
evidence: 回家以后孟子在家坐着，从早到晚一直学习，
scenes.missing_part: 孟母 moves from the market to a neighbourhood near a school

scenes.core: 孟子 becomes a famous philosopher
evidence: 难怪他决定成为哲学家，原来他想给别的人建议。
scenes.missing_part: 孟子 becomes famous as a philosopher

feedback: Before the graveyard scene, add that 孟子 and 孟母 lived near the graveyard.
After 孟子 copies the offerings at the graveyard, add that 孟母 worries this will harm him and moves away.
After they leave the graveyard area, add that they live near a market and 孟子 copies buying and selling.
Before 孟子 studies every day, add that 孟母 moves from the market area to a place near a school.
At the end, add that 孟子 becomes a famous philosopher.
